sb.name: Drake Companion
sb.damage_immunities: determined by the drake's draconic essence trait

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + five times your ranger level (the drake has a number of hit dice [d10s] equal to your ranger level)

traits.name: Draconic Essence
traits.desc: When you summon the drake, choose a damage type: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The chosen type determines the drake's damage immunity, the damage of its bite, and the damage of its Infused Strikes trait.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 + PB to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 piercing damage plus PB damage of a type determined by the drake's Draconic Essence.

reactions.name: Infused Strikes
reactions.desc: When another creature within 30 feet of the drake that it can see hits with a weapon attack, the drake infuses the strike with its essence, causing the attack to deal an extra 1d6 damage of the type determined by its Draconic Essence.
